description: Screenshot of Q drop #4316 as rendered in a dark-themed Q aggregator app, headed 'Link to New Q Drop' and dated 24 May 2020. The drop links to a tweet by the account 2020Qanon and asks whether the quoted line 'all will be well right after the election' refers to the virus or the election.
text: 4316. Link to New Q Drop. Q !!Hs1Jq13jV6 24 May 2020 - 5:09:31 PM. https://twitter.com/2020Qanon/status/1264661017721745414. Fear not, all will be well right after the election. Is this about the virus OR THE ELECTION? Q
flags: Q-drop content transcribed as the drop's claim, not asserted

description: Black-and-white 'keyboard warrior' / digital-soldier meme photograph. A bearded man in a U.S.-flag-patched cap, headset, tactical plate carrier and backpack cradles a computer keyboard the way a rifle would be carried; his chest pouches hold beverage cans instead of magazines. The image was widely shared in Q circles to represent anonymous online 'digital soldiers'.
flags: Subject is an unidentified man; treated as an anonymous meme figure

description: Photograph taken from a vehicle on a rainy highway showing a large hand-painted tarp banner hung from a highway overpass reading 'Cuomo KILLED MY MOM' in red letters. The banner is a protest referencing Gov. Andrew Cuomo, circulated amid criticism of New York's COVID-19 nursing-home policy. The exact highway and location are not shown.
flags: Banner names only 'Cuomo'; reference to Gov. Andrew Cuomo inferred from context
Location and banner author unidentified; the banner's accusation is a protest claim, not a verified fact

description: Quote-card meme in the AZ Quotes template: a photograph of George Soros beside white text on black attributing to him the quote 'Destroying America will be the culmination of my life's work.' The attribution is presented by the card as genuine; fact-checkers have found no record of Soros saying this, and the quote is widely reported as fabricated.
text: Destroying America will be the culmination of my life's work. — George Soros —. AZ QUOTES
flags: Attributed quote is unverified and widely reported as fabricated; carried here as the card's claim only
